caption:
Carrying the whole church on your back? You've got it upside down. (1 Timothy 3:15–16 devotional)

We exhaust ourselves feeling we must hold the truth — and the whole community — up alone. But the church doesn't hold the truth up; the truth holds it. Before you carry it, Christ the Truth is already carrying you.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — what weight are you carrying that isn't yours to hold?
